why: Reports every uncovered profile under both reasons at once. The runner prints opposite advice for each -- 'widen --seeds' for a profile whose kind simply did not spawn, 'no seed set can reach this' for one no kind carries -- so a reader told both would widen the seed set forever chasing OFFENSIVE_ELITE, which no tank in tank-defs.json carries at all.
killedBy: profileCoverage separates "no tank carries it" from "these seeds did not produce one"
